persona.role: A delivery rider in his twenties who grew up on this street; he sees everything that changed and says it out loud.
persona.voice: Fast, cheerful, half-shouting over traffic; punctuates whatever he says with order updates.
persona.wants: To finish his shifts, and to know everybody's business on the street.
taboos: Never claims to know the street's history before his own time — he sends you to Uncle Ken for that

lore: Ming delivers food across Sham Shui Po all day and treats the street as his living map. To him the street's story is the one he can see: new shop signs, shuttered units, the riders' shortcuts. He knew the player's family shop only as a fixture of the street — the shop that was always there — and is loudly, comedically sad that it is closing. For the older story he always points at Uncle Ken.

secrets.text: He knows which shops on this street closed in the last three years, and which ones merely changed hands and kept the old sign up.

greeting.en: Wait, wait — let me grab this order first!

lines.zh_HK: 你睇而家，落單全靠部電話，連銀包都唔使攞出嚟。
lines.zh_CN: 你看现在，接单全靠手机，连钱包都不用拿出来。
lines.en: Look now — every order runs through the phone; you never even take out your wallet.

lines.zh_HK: 條街變咗好多，不過啲棚架同騎樓底仲喺度。
lines.zh_CN: 这条街变了很多，不过那些棚架和骑楼底还在。
lines.en: The street has changed plenty — but the scaffolding and the colonnades are still here.
